summary: The ProtobufJsonPayloadConverter fails when using a shaded artifact because shaded protobuf types (io.temporal.shaded.com.google.protobuf.*) don't match non-shaded client code types (com.google.protobuf.*), causing instanceof checks to fail and serialization to be skipped.
userImpact: Users attempting to use the shaded artifact for gRPC version conflict resolution cannot serialize protobuf messages, forcing them to choose between gRPC conflicts or losing protobuf support.
rootCause: When protobuf is shaded by relocation, com.google.protobuf.MessageOrBuilder becomes io.temporal.shaded.com.google.protobuf.MessageOrBuilder, causing instanceof checks to fail when non-shaded client code passes regular protobuf objects.
proposedFix: Release ProtobufJsonPayloadConverter as a separate non-shaded artifact independent from the shaded artifact, or configure the shader to exclude converters from relocation.
keyQuote: once protobuf is shaded, io.temporal.shaded.com.google.protobuf.* is a completely different type from com.google.protobuf.*
